title: Production Staff Pilot Readiness Test
objective: Prove that a restaurant staff member can run a normal shift using the current production staff dashboard without owner intervention, fixing only a confirmed handover-blocking repository defect if the production-safe pilot exposes one.
goal: The production staff dashboard is ready for a restaurant staff pilot: normal order, status, payment, cancellation, persistence, retry and tablet workflows work without owner intervention.
context: ATLAS-005 is completed, merged and deployed at commit a6821eedc4b30265bffbe56d2b1f1bccc8affcf7. This task is QA-first, not feature expansion. Start from the current Production behavior and automated contracts. Use production-safe orders labelled as tests and never send a real customer message. Verify the customer-to-staff flow, dine-in and takeaway clarity, normal status progression, Cash, staff-verified dine-in Transfer, paid/cancelled guards, refresh persistence, duplicate/repeated actions, understandable network/error behavior, and tablet usability. If every criterion is already satisfied, make no product change. If and only if a handover-blocking repository defect is proven, fix the smallest defect inside allowedPaths, extend the closest existing regression test, re-run required checks and continue the pilot. Do not alter Messenger payment-proof behavior, Supabase schema, n8n, Vercel configuration, owner features, menu design, analytics or reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: The current Production deployment for main is ready and serves the staff dashboard.
A production-safe customer test order appears on the staff dashboard with correct items, totals and identity.
Dine-in table details and takeaway details are clear without owner assistance.
Staff can progress an eligible order through the normal status flow and terminal guards prevent invalid backward or repeated transitions.
Paid Cash marks an eligible order Paid with method Cash and a stable paid_at value.
Paid by QR / Transfer marks an eligible dine-in order Paid with method Transfer, creates no proof row and preserves the Messenger proof flow.
Cancelled orders cannot be progressed or paid, and paid orders are not corrupted by cancellation or payment replays.
Refreshing or reopening the production staff dashboard preserves server state and displays it accurately.
Duplicate or repeated status, payment and cancellation actions are idempotent or fail safely without corrupting state.
Basic failed-request, retry and recovery states are understandable to staff and do not falsely report success.
The production staff dashboard remains readable and operable at a tablet-sized viewport.
No owner intervention, real customer message, unrelated product change, schema change or configuration change is required for the pilot.

stoppingRules: Do not change product code unless a production pilot observation proves a handover-blocking defect.
Fix only the smallest proven defect and only inside allowedPaths.
Stop if a fix would require changing Messenger payment-proof implementation, database schema, n8n, Vercel configuration, secrets, owner features or menu behavior.
Stop before sending any real customer message or using a real customer identity.
Use only clearly labelled production-safe test orders; do not repurpose a real order.
Stop if success depends on an owner-only action during a normal staff shift.
Stop for a genuine human usability decision when evidence cannot distinguish PASS from NOT READY.
Stop if the same failure repeats twice without new evidence.
Stop and escalate after two unsuccessful revision rounds.
